senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (केतयति)
1 To call or invite.
2 To counsel or advise; some authorities substitute सङ्केत for this root.

m. (-तः)
A house, an abode.
E.
कित to abide, affix घञ्.

mf. (-कः-की)
A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
E.
किति to abide, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 A flag, a banner.
2 Business, indispensable act.
3 Invitation.
4 A spot or mark, a sign, a symbol.
5 A house, an abode.
6 Place, site, situation, &c.
E.
कित to abide, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Called, summoned.
2 Dwelt, inhabited.
E.
केत to call, or कित to dwell, affix क्त.

m. (-तुः)
KETU the dragon's tail or descending node; in astronomy, the ninth of the planets; in mythology, a demon: the body of SAIṂHIKEYA severed from the head (RĀHU), by VIṢṆU, at the churning of the ocean, but immortal, by having tasted the Amṛta.
2 A banner, a flag.
3 A mark, a sign, a symbol, &c.
4 Light.
5 A comet, a falling star, &c.
6 Disease.
7 A pigmy race inhabiting Kusa Dvīpa, the progeny of JAIMINI.
E.
चाय to worship, तु Uṇādi affix, कि substituted for the root.

f. (-रा)
A comet.
E.
केतु, and तारा a star.

m. (-भः)
A cloud.
E.
केतु the plant, and भ what resembles it in darkness.

n. (-लं)
One of nine great divisions of the known world, the western portion or Varṣa of Jambu Dvīpa.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A flag-staff.
E.
केतु, and यष्टि a stick.

n. (-त्नं)
Lapis lazuli.
E.
केतु, and रत्न a gem.

m. (-नः)
A flag.
E.
केतु a standard, and वसन cloth.
